title: MCI response to PQ on Info Comm and Media Professionals Required to Support Games Sector
publisher: Singapore Ministry of Communications and Information, now MDDI
methodology: The parliamentary answer says the Annual Survey on Infocomm Media Manpower provides an indicative sense of demand based on companies' growth expectations. It does not publish the realised-employment method for the 2021 nearly-2,000 figure.
assessment: Only located national games-sector employment stock: nearly 2,000 people in 2021. The text explicitly distinguishes it from the projected 2,700 demand, and discusses the sector with esports context; it is not a pure developer/publisher series.
next_step: Use only as the existing broad 2021 snapshot unless IMDA releases a games-only realised-employment table.

title: Singapore Games Association home page
methodology: The association says it issues annual data reports on the Singapore games industry, but its public sitemap exposes no report archive or downloadable data report.
assessment: This establishes that SGGA is a relevant annual-report lead, but does not itself provide an employment count, methodology, or retrievable annual series.
access_status: public home page and sitemap inspected; no public report URL located
next_step: Do not infer data availability from the claim. Recheck only if SGGA publishes a report or public methodology/data link.

title: SGGA Townhall update reposted by an SGGA-linked industry participant
publisher: Singapore Games Association update, surfaced in LinkedIn public search
methodology: The update says SGGA priorities include refreshing its industry survey and transparency; the data is 'still rough and being refined.'
assessment: Corroborates that an industry survey is not a released, stable annual employment series. It offers no count and should not be turned into a time-series observation.
next_step: Treat as a publication-status limitation, not quantitative evidence.

title: Tech and Media Talent
years: 2020-2025 workbook series reviewed in prior archive pass
methodology: IMDA public workbook has tech/media totals and sector/sex breakdowns, but no games-specific workforce row or industry-class series.
assessment: Not usable for games employment. A broad technology/media total cannot be allocated to games.
access_status: official public portal and linked workbook previously inspected
next_step: Seek a released table for SSIC 58201 and 62012 or a games-specific realised-employment disclosure.
